title: Unconscious Bias @ Work | Google Ventures
summary: A Google Ventures talk on how unconscious biases shape product decisions, hiring and workplace interactions. It draws on research, including work by Google scientists, on how to counter them.
why: HN recommends it as an interesting look at the psychology research behind bias in hiring and performance reviews.

quote.text: Google has a training video that talks through some interesting psychology research that ties to hiring / performance reviews
